business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Simulated Social Casino and Virtual Slots Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Unitary National Jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: U.S. common law tradition; RMI Constitution (1979); statutory corporate law modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law; customary law in land tenure matters; corporate registry administered by the Registrar of Corporations with licensed registered agents
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the RMI (1986, as amended 2003)
US-Pacific Islands Trade and Investment Framework Agreement (TIFA)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) - RMI signatory/participating forum framework
No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) in force; only limited tax/exchange-of-information arrangements with the United States under the CFA and general international standards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, codified as Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (51 MIRC), as amended; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000 (FTRA), as amended by the Financial Transactions Reporting (Amendment) Act 2021 and regulations issued by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Registrar of Corporations; RMI is subject to FATF mutual evaluation and maintains AML/CFT obligations substantive to the FTRA for registered agents, corporate service providers and financial institutions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Articles of Incorporation (original) and certified copy approved by proposed directors/shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed incorporator(s) / directors / shareholders in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI is a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; documents from Contracting Parties are apostilled at origin) OR Consular Legalization for non-Contracting Party origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and CDD Questionnaire (FTRA compliant, including source of funds and beneficial ownership chain to natural person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certificate of Incumbency / Registered Agent Certification of Directors and Officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued domestically in RMI; notarized by RMI notary with no further consular chain required for RMI domestic use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original Bank Reference Letter and banker's certificate for each UBO/principal (AML due diligence supporting document)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate or retail bank of the UBO at country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Consent and Acceptance Form (statutory office acceptance)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Executed domestically in RMI; no foreign authentication required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and authorized signatories against: (i) UN Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) OFAC SDN List and OFAC sectoral/country sanctions; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) UK HM Treasury Consolidated List; (v) RMI FIU domestic watchlists and FATF public statements (black/grey list risk flags); PEP status must be declared and mitigated with enhanced due diligence (EDD) for high-risk national or politically exposed persons; negative media and adverse regulatory checks are contractual requirements of the licensed RMI registered agent under FTRA obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI Companies Registry), Majuro; name reservation applications are submitted by a licensed RMI Registered Agent through the Registry's submission procedures (official portal and public data access via the Registrar's corporate registry services; there is no fully self-service public filing portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate records and registered name must be in English using Latin characters; the name must contain a corporate suffix of Corporation, Incorporated, Company, or Limited, or an accepted abbreviation (Corp., Inc., Co., Ltd.); names using characters outside the standard Latin alphabet, accented marks, or non-Latin script will be transliterated into English at registration; only the transliterated English name is registered; punctuation is restricted to standard corporate separators
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Surety (require prior RMI Banking Act / Insurance Act license and ministerial consent)
Government, Authority, Agency, Municipal, National, State, Board, Chamber of Commerce (require ministerial approval or evidence of government affiliation)
University, College, Institute, Academy, Medical, Hospital (usually restricted or subject to qualification review)

Gaming, Casino, Slots, Betting, Lottery (for this social-casino/simulated slots scope, a statutory no-license legal opinion must accompany the name application; the name token may trigger review by the Registry and the Attorney-General's office)
Exchange, Fund, Investment, Securities, Broker, Dealer, Financial, Capital (subject to RMI financial services licensing or regulatory clearance)
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered RMI entity or a protected foreign name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's licensed registered agent shall submit a written request for reconsideration to the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days, citing the statutory basis under 51 MIRC and providing evidence of consent of an existing nameholder (if applicable) or amendment of the requested name; if the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the Minister of Resources and Development or the appropriate Cabinet minister within 30 days; judicial review may be sought before the High Court of the Marshall Islands if the administrative remedy is exhausted; during the appeal no other applicant may reserve the disputed name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted – the non-resident Business Corporation is not required to maintain physical premises in RMI; a licensed RMI Registered Agent shall provide the statutory registered office address and the corporation may operate fully from overseas. The registered agent must maintain a physical street address in the RMI capable of accepting legal service of process; virtual/agency office arrangements are standard and acceptable for this software publishing industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated under 5% annual probability for unannounced physical on-site inspection of a non-resident tax-exempt entity). The RMI Registrar focuses on records inspection of registered agents and compliance with FTRA-required UBO/CDD files; FIU risk-based examinations or targeted inspections may occur if a transaction pattern, sanctions link, or regulatory complaint elevates the risk profile from medium-risk-enhanced to high-risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and reservation application fee (through licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent (pass-through to Registrar of Corporations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of RMI registered agents; statutory reservation fee is nominal, agent service fee dominates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for Articles of Incorporation (Business Corporation, non-resident, no minimum capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under 51 MIRC and Registrar fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Agent and statutory Registered Office fee (first year of service)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; includes the FTRA-mandated physical registered office and acceptance of service of process

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/CDD file set-up, PEP and OFAC/UN sanctions screening, AML compliance onboarding
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent / RMI AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for FTRA-compliant CDD onboarding of medium-risk-enhanced non-financial corporate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization bundle (Articles, UBO declarations, incumbency and bank reference document authentication)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin; competent authority issuing apostille (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State); RMI consular/legalization channel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of issuing authority plus prevailing notarial market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal opinion (no-license analysis for simulated social casino and virtual slots under RMI law; ISIC 5820 applicability)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External RMI-qualified attorney or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a fixed-scope legal opinion

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and secure document transmission for apostilled/legalized originals

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended; Sections 23–30 (Articles of Incorporation), Section 34 (Bylaws), Section 52 (Registered Office and Agent), Sections 73–79 (Directors and Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the Business Corporations Act. The sole incorporator may authorize share issuance for any lawful consideration determined by the board; no escrow account or capital deposit is required prior to incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Corporation be and hereby is approved, and the officers are authorized to execute and file the Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations of the Marshall Islands. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopt its Bylaws and elect the following persons as directors for the first year of existence. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the board accept the subscription for shares set forth in the subscription agreement and issue the consideration required thereunder. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be as stated in the Articles of Incorporation, and the registered agent is appointed to act for the Corporation. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following officers be appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request via the official Marshall Islands Registry online portal, specifying the exact proposed corporate name containing 'Business Corporation' or an approved abbreviation. Conduct a prior availability search to ensure the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. The certificate of name reservation, if granted, is valid for 30 days and must be attached to the subsequent incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and authorized share structure statement
Identification of the incorporator or submitting agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an amended request with an alternate distinct name or submit a consent letter from the holder of a similar name authorizing the use. The Registry usually notifies the deficiency within one business day, and the application may be resubmitted within the same SLA window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in English, including the corporation name, registered office address, registered agent consent, purpose clause, authorized capital structure, and number of directors. Obtain notarization of the incorporator's signature by a notary public or an officer of a licensed corporate service provider. Pay the US$350 filing fee and submit the original notarized Articles together with the name reservation certificate and registered agent consent form to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent to act (Form RA-1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for substantive defect, correct and resubmit the affected page or schedule within 21 days. The Registrar may be requested to expedite via the 24-hour expedited filing service for an additional statutorily prescribed fee; all outstanding corrections must be cured before the certificate of incorporation is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the newly incorporated entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the certificate of incorporation, convene a formal first board meeting (in person, telephonic, or written consent) at the registered office. The board adopts the corporate bylaws, ratifies the subscription of shares, elects initial directors, appoints the named officers, and designates the registered office and agent as consistent with the Articles. Minutes and written consents must be signed by the director(s) and maintained in the corporate record book.
required_dossiers: Consent to serve as director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: No registry action applies as this is an internal corporate governance step. If there is a defect in share issuance or officer election, convene an adjourned or subsequent board meeting and ratify the action; ratification by unanimous written consent may be used for expediency under Section 85 of the BCA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Non-Resident Domestic Entity Status and Post-Incorporation Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Registry; Annual Roar and Taxation Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File any applicable post-incorporation notice to denote the corporation as a Non-Resident Domestic Entity for purposes of the BCA, which enables tax-exempt status for non-Marshall Islands sourced income. Submit the initial corporate register entry listing the directors, officers, and registered agent to the Registry. Where the corporation conducts no local activities, confirm the absence of any sales or payroll tax registration obligations.
required_dossiers: Notice of non-resident domestic entity status (where required)
Payment of any annual franchise or registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry disputes non-resident status, provide a statutory declaration confirming no local revenue and no local physical office; re-file with the required supporting evidence. Any late fee may be waived upon showing good cause within the first 30 days after initial certificate issuance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Investment and Trade Authority (no industrial license required for digital software publishing)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None — virtual social casino and slots game publishing is not subject to a local statutory operating or manufacturing permit in the Republic of the Marshall Islands

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure digital software activity with no physical discharge, stationary emissions, or hazardous waste generation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for remote software operations. If physical office infrastructure is later established, the facility must comply with the general wastewater and solid waste management standards under the Environmental Protection Act 1984, including the prohibition of untreated industrial waste into public waters and the requirement for proper disposal of electronic waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for a distributed team with no physical place of business. If a physical office or server room is opened, the employer must obtain fire safety clearance from the Majuro Fire Department, satisfy structural load inspection for any heavy equipment under the Building Code of the Marshall Islands, and undergo workplace safety inspection by the Occupational Health and Safety Office of the Ministry of Health and Human Services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Bureau (RTB) — official national tax authority; tax administration portal accessible via https://rtb.mh (foreign investor guidance issued by the Ministry of Finance and the Registrar of Corporations).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned Business Corporations incorporated under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act are not automatically registered for income tax because their offshore-derived income is exempt. A foreign entity seeking a statutory TIN obtains it only when it generates Marshall Islands domestic-source income or elects to be treated as a domestic taxpayer. Procedure: file Form RTB-TIN-1 with the Revenue and Taxation Bureau at the Office of the Registrar, attach the Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Corporations, provide a copy of the Articles of Incorporation, a notarized statement of non-resident status, and a Declaration of No Local Source Income; the RTB issues a TIN within 5 business days for administrative identification purposes but with a tax exemption certificate under the Income Tax Act (Chapter 20) if the entity confirms it will derive no Marshall Islands source income. For export-focused gaming software publishers, no active TIN is required by default; the non-resident corporation may operate solely on the basis of a Clean Exemption Certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Business Corporations Act (BCA) permits a foreign-owned corporation to elect in its Articles or by board resolution to be classified as a Non-Resident Business Corporation (NRBC), which is automatically outside the scope of Marshall Islands income tax. There exists no check-the-box classification equivalent to the U.S. or a hybrid mismatch election under Marshall Islands law, but the entity may further elect under Section 84 of the BCA to restrict its activities to offshore commercial operations, thereby rendering all income, profits, and transactions entirely tax-neutral. Where the gaming company holds an election to remain a domestic taxable corporation, it may later revoke that election to revert to non-resident status; this is not a hybrid mismatch instrument but a statutory exemption election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / No GST / No General Sales and Use Tax — Marshall Islands levies no broad-based indirect tax at the national level
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no indirect tax registration threshold exists because no indirect tax is imposed; the de facto threshold is zero and no fiscal registration for indirect tax purposes is triggered by economic turnover in the Marshall Islands
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — the Marshall Islands does not mandate e-invoicing, fiscal clearance APIs, or digital stamping; record-keeping requirements are confined to general corporate books under the Business Corporations Act (minimum 5 years of storage, no digital fiscal integration requirement)

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in a VAT/GST context: the Marshall Islands imposes no indirect tax and therefore provides no VAT zero-rating mechanism for exports or offshore services. For direct tax purposes, a Non-Resident Business Corporation deriving income from publishing and licensing social casino software to foreign consumers is wholly outside the Marshall Islands income tax net. The concept of '0% export rating' is replaced by the statutory exemption of foreign-source income under the Income Tax Act, Section 4(1)(a) — provided that the contract for sale or license of the software is executed outside the Marshall Islands, payment is received through a foreign banking channel, and no office or permanent establishment in the Marshall Islands is maintained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Letter of Certification from the Registrar of Corporations confirming the entity's Non-Resident Business Corporation status
Board Resolution declaring all income to be foreign-source and not arising from the Republic of the Marshall Islands
Digital software delivery manifest or electronic export record (where applicable, no physical goods enter customs)
Foreign bank account statement showing SWIFT/ACH inward remittance from the overseas counterparty
Signed software license agreement or service agreement evidencing offshore place of performance
Certificate of Exemption issued by the Revenue and Taxation Bureau (RTB Form EX-105)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Marshall Islands tax law imposes no explicit VAT export zero-rating clawback because no VAT exists. However, where an exempt non-resident entity mischaracterizes domestic-source income (e.g., revenue from a Marshall Islands resident customer or from a PE in Majuro) as foreign-source income, the Revenue and Taxation Bureau may retroactively assess income tax at the standard rate of 3% for corporations (or 11% under the alternative minimum regime if applicable), add a 25% civil fraud penalty, and calculate statutory interest at 1% per month from the original due date. In flagrant cases, the Registrar may petition the High Court to revoke the Non-Resident status, resulting in full retroactive taxation of all accumulated undistributed profits. The RTB also retains criminal enforcement powers under the Income Tax Act (Amendment) 2021 for deliberately falsified exemption certificates, with fines up to $50,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years for responsible officers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); no domestic central bank exists, and the U.S. Federal Reserve serves as the de facto monetary authority under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The officially adopted currency is the U.S. dollar (USD). There are no foreign exchange controls in the RMI. Current and capital account transactions are fully convertible; profit remittances, dividend distributions, and liquidation proceeds may be freely repatriated without exchange control approval, subject only to normal banking due diligence, AML verification, and OFAC sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory requirement exists for the surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds. Businesses may retain receipts in USD or convert to other currencies freely. The RMI imposes no exchange control regime, no centralized reporting of current account receipts, and no repatriation timeline beyond standard commercial practices.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is low. The RMI has no fintech or electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs cannot directly provide local account facilities; they may only offer virtual IBAN backing via partner banks, but settlement ultimately requires a U.S. correspondent clearing relationship. Legal constraints arise from the absence of a central bank, limited banking sector infrastructure, and FATF-styled AML supervision.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally not mandatory for non-resident business corporations for initial account opening; remote KYC is permissible subject to certified corporate documents and enhanced due diligence. Banks in Majuro/Guam may, however, require one director or the ultimate beneficial owner to take part in a live video interview. For virtual slots gaming businesses, in-branch interview may be required if the compliance review identifies elevated money laundering risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry classification as simulated gaming / social casino (ISIC 5820) triggering enhanced due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan proving no real-money gambling; no payout of winnings in fiat or cryptocurrency; legal opinion confirming non-gambling status under RMI and target-market law; platform terms and conditions prohibiting cash-out; Apple App Store and Google Play content categorization letters; audited financial statements; AML compliance manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with offshore directors and tax-exempt status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and articles; ISO/ELF status certificate; register of directors and shareholders; passport copies and proof of residential address for all beneficial owners; professional background checks; notarized board resolutions; source of wealth statement; corporate registry due diligence report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume low-value inbound traffic from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, with potential structuring red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements with Apple and Google; payout statements and reconciliation records; payment processor settlement reports; internal transaction monitoring procedures; modelled flow diagrams showing user microtransactions; compliance team credentials; state of the art anti-fraud analytics; consent to independent audit by the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital from shareholders is routed via SWIFT MT103 using the purpose code 'Equity Capital Injection' (IMF BPM6 category E.510/513) or 'Business Capital Contribution' where a specific code is not available. The remittance narrative must reference the MH_BC corporate entity, the share subscription agreement, and the bank account in Majuro. Verification for credit comprises: signed capitalization resolution, share subscription documents, source-of-funds declaration for each injector, OFAC/sanctions screening, and where applicable FATCA/CRS self-certification forms.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for operational suppliers, licensing fees, and content royalties are cleared via SWIFT MT103/MT202 (USD correspondent through Fedwire/CHIPS). Commercial letters of credit (L/C) may be issued using UCP600 for physical goods or contract performance guarantees, but for digital simulated slots services the standard clearing rail is a plain SWIFT wire transfer with a documented invoice and treasury manager approval. The local reporting bank applies the usual OFAC screening, and transactions are subject to corroborative KYC checks on beneficiaries.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla deliverable FX forwards between USD and major convertible currencies (EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD) for anticipated operational outflows
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or illiquid regional currencies (e.g., certain emerging market currencies) to synthetically hedge settlement risk
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCS) to hedge long-term foreign-currency exposures on non-USD funding or major platform-related receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Statement of Particulars) filing under Section 92 of the Marshall Islands Business Corporation Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within ninety (90) days after each anniversary of the date on which the Articles of Incorporation were filed; no statutory extension is available from the Registrar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of US$100 per report if submitted after the due date; continued non-filing for one year removes the corporation from good standing; two consecutive missed annual reports result in administrative dissolution (strike-off) by the Registrar, termination of legal personality, and reinstatement only after payment of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax settlement for non-resident business corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable concurrently with the annual report within the ninety (90) day post-anniversary window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Franchise tax not settled in full renders the annual report invalid; the Registrar will not issue a Certificate of Good Standing or consent to share transfers; unresolved franchise tax accrues interest and forms a lien enforceable by judicial winding-up in the RMI High Court.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit is compulsory if the corporation exceeds two of the following: total assets US$1,000,000, annual gross revenue US$2,000,000, or more than 50 shareholders; a smaller or inactive non-resident social casino publisher may waive audit by unanimous shareholder resolution. A licensed or publicly offered corporation is always audited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands has no domestic GAAP; financial statements may be prepared under IFRS as issued by the IASB or US GAAP. Tax-exempt non-resident corporations are not required to file an income tax return unless carrying on taxable RMI-source business.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Business Corporation Act requires the corporation and its registered agent to keep the share register current. On each annual report, the registered agent must certify that every share transfer effectuated in the previous twelve months has been recorded, that the names and addresses of record shareholders reflect the true economic ownership, and that beneficial ownership records have been refreshed under RMI Beneficial Ownership Regulations. Non-resident shareholders may transfer freely, but the transfer is only valid against the corporation once inscribed in the share register, and such inscription must be confirmed no later than the anniversary filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$350 - US$1,200 per year for a local licensed corporate agent providing registered office, agent service, and annual report coordination
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$8,000 - US$25,000 per engagement for a certified RMI auditor if the compulsory threshold is exceeded; not material for a dormant exempt publisher

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — non-resident Business Corporations are exempt from all Marshall Islands income tax; the 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies only to revenue derived from business conducted within the Republic and must be avoided by a compliant offshore BC.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Perpetual statutory exemption from income, capital gains, and withholding taxes for non-resident domestic corporations; no payroll tax, no branch profits tax, no accumulated earnings tax; the minimum USD 250 annual report fee is the de facto franchise tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BCA Annual Report (no separate CIT return exists in the RMI) — filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the licensed registered agent; e-filing accepted via the RMI Online Services portal maintained by the Office of the Attorney General.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary date of filing the Articles of Incorporation, rather than a fixed fiscal-year-end date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the BC as set out in the Articles of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered name exactly; any change requires a prior amendment filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 2 — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical RMI address of the resident agent and of the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Marshall Islands-licensed registered agent is mandatory; the agent receives service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name and residential address of each director and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and officers are permitted; no RMI residency requirement exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes, series, and number of authorized shares; this is the basis for calculating the annual report fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minimum fee of USD 250 applies to corporations authorized to issue 10,000 or fewer shares; fees scale with authorized capital.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the BC is a non-resident domestic corporation conducting no business in the RMI and deriving no RMI-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be truthfully affirmed; false certification revokes the 0% exemption and triggers the 3% Gross Revenue Tax with penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of USD 250 per report; failure to file for two consecutive years authorizes administrative dissolution by the Registrar; directors who continue trading after dissolution become jointly and severally liable for all post-dissolution debts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form GRT-1 — Gross Revenue Tax Return (3% GRT) under the Revenue and Taxation Act; filed with the RMI Ministry of Finance (Customs and Tax Office) through the registered agent or by paper submission.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual on a calendar-year basis, subject to the instalment schedule prescribed by the Secretary of Finance
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and remittance due within the statutory period following each tax period; in practice quarterly instalments with an annual reconciliation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross revenue derived from all business activity sourced within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A compliant non-resident BC files nil and remains exempt; no GRT return is required where no RMI-source business is conducted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exclusions and the basis of the exemption certificate relied upon.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cite the Business Corporations Act non-resident exemption if the tax office challenges nil reporting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue less exemptions, multiplied by the statutory 3% rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must remain nil for a pure offshore publisher of simulated social casino and virtual slots games.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment penalty of 10% plus monthly statutory interest (1% per month); wilful evasion attracts a fraud penalty of up to 50% of the understated tax and criminal conviction with fines up to USD 5,000 and imprisonment up to one year.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI imposes no withholding tax, no dividend tax, and no undistributed-profits tax on distributions by a BC to non-resident shareholders; social casino profits may be repatriated gross without RMI formalities.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive Double Tax Agreement network; only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (with the US, Australia, New Zealand) and a US bilateral investment treaty exist. Treaty relief at source is therefore inapplicable — the RMI issues no Tax Residency Certificate because no RMI tax is deducted at source; shareholders instead export income to their residence state, where the RMI 0% rate creates no foreign tax credit and the income is fully taxed (e.g., US GILTI when the BC is a CFC).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on cross-border royalties, including gaming software IP licensing, and on debt interest paid to non-residents is 0%; no treaty rates are applicable. If the BC erroneously becomes RMI-resident through local activity, the 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies to gross RMI-source royalty and interest revenue, but this is a revenue tax on the recipient entity, not a withholding tax on the outbound payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — the RMI has no OECD-aligned transfer pricing statute, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no related-party threshold denominated in local currency (USD). Nonetheless, contemporaneous OECD TP documentation is recommended where the BC licenses gaming software or charges service fees to related parties in CFC jurisdictions and cross-border intercompany flows exceed USD 3,000,000 per annum, because foreign tax authorities will apply arm's-length tests to the group's economics.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — Comparable Uncontrolled Price (for IP licensing and platform fee benchmarks)
Resale Price Method (for distribution of virtual content and in-app purchase aggregation)
Cost Plus Method (for game development and support services)
TNMM — Transactional Net Margin Method (for routine publishing and user acquisition functions)
Profit Split Method (for integrated social casino platform and shared IP profit arrangements)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No domestic Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) are codified in the RMI; the BCA exemption is available without a local substance test. De facto substance requirements arise extraterritorially: the OECD BEPS Inclusive Framework reviews the RMI's no-or-nominal-tax regime, EU and UK anti-avoidance directives impose CFC rules, and US Subpart F/GILTI attributes income to US shareholders of the RMI BC. A letterbox operator must demonstrate real operational substance — game development staff, IP ownership, procurement and user-acquisition decision-making — in its actual management jurisdiction to prevent recharacterization by foreign courts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — False Non-Resident Exemption Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying non-resident status while conducting RMI-source business (local employees, RMI office, marketing to RMI residents) and concealing gross revenue to avoid the 3% Gross Revenue Tax; alternatively, backdating or forging the exemption certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the exemption certificate; retroactive reassessment of the 3% GRT on all RMI-source gross revenue; 10% late-filing penalty; monthly statutory interest; fraud penalty up to 50% of the understated tax; criminal prosecution with fines up to USD 5,000 and imprisonment up to one year under the Revenue and Taxation Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who approved the false declaration are jointly and severally liable for the reassessed tax, penalties, and interest; after administrative dissolution, directors continuing the business are personally liable for all post-dissolution debts; senior officers also face criminal prosecution and RMI entry or travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the social casino publisher as a pure letterbox BC with no employees, no business records, and no board decision-making; all substantive functions — game development, payment processing, marketing — are performed from the shareholder's residence while the BC claims 0% exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No RMI domestic sanction exists, but foreign consequences are severe: US shareholders face GILTI inclusion, PFIC taint, and a 20% accuracy-related penalty on understatements; EU/UK CFC rules impose income attribution with interest and penalty surcharges; an OECD tax administration may disregard the BC as an artificial arrangement and re-seat the profits at the ultimate shareholder level.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign revenue authorities may pierce the corporate veil, holding directors and nominee shareholders personally liable for unpaid foreign taxes plus penalties of up to 40% of the understated income; travel bans, director disqualification orders, and cross-border tax warrants are pursued against controlling persons.
